title: GoldenTask
description: A single entry in the golden-task corpus used to drive regression evals for a coding agent. Each entry defines an input, the expected artifact, and the scoring criteria.

id.description: Stable, kebab-case identifier. Never reuse or rename — eval history is keyed on this.

version.description: Increment when the expected output or scoring criteria change materially. Old versions should be archived, not overwritten.

task.description: The agent input: the prompt the agent receives, plus optional repo snapshot and tool permissions.

prompt.description: The exact prompt string sent to the agent. No template variables — must be fully rendered.

repo_snapshot.description: Path or URI to a deterministic repo fixture (tarball, git ref, or fixture ID) the agent operates on. Omit for prompt-only tasks.

allowed_tools.description: Tool names the agent is permitted to use during this task. Overrides session defaults.

max_turns.description: Hard turn limit for this task. If the agent exceeds this, the run is scored as a timeout.

context_files.description: Files to pre-load into the agent's context window before the prompt.

expected.description: The expected output artifact and acceptance criteria.

artifact_type.description: Structural type of the expected output.

artifact_path.description: File path (relative to repo root) of the expected artifact. Required for 'file_diff' and 'file_create'.

content.description: Expected content string or JSON-serialized object. For 'file_diff', this is a unified diff.

content_schema.description: JSON Schema that the artifact content must satisfy. Mutually exclusive with 'content'.

contains.description: Substrings that must appear in the artifact. Evaluated after 'content' check.

excludes.description: Substrings that must NOT appear in the artifact.

method.description: Primary scoring method. 'llm_judge' requires a judge_prompt. 'custom' requires a scorer_ref.

fuzzy_threshold.description: Minimum similarity ratio (0–1) required to pass. Used when method = 'fuzzy_match'.

judge_prompt.description: System prompt for the LLM judge. Must instruct the judge to return a JSON object with a 'pass' boolean and 'reason' string. Used when method = 'llm_judge'.

scorer_ref.description: Module path or URI to a custom scorer callable (e.g. 'evals.scorers:check_typescript_compiles'). Used when method = 'custom'.

pass_threshold.description: Fraction of sub-checks that must pass for the task to be marked as passed. Allows partial credit.

baseline.description: Reference scores from the last known-good run. Used to detect regression.

metadata.description: Free-form key-value pairs for tooling (CI pipeline ID, author, linked issue, etc.).

task.prompt: Add explicit return types to all exported functions in src/utils.ts that are missing them.

scoring.judge_prompt: You are a TypeScript expert. The agent was asked to add return types. Return {"pass": true/false, "reason": "..."}. Pass if all exported functions now have explicit return types and no 'any' was introduced.
